prompt.exact_text:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: one static body plate for a two-layer PNG mascot animation.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: approved Astral B idle frame-000.png. Follow this exact image for identity, body width, proportions, silhouette, face, material, lighting and camera.
Primary request: remove ONLY the small attached flipper on IMAGE-LEFT (the viewer's left, Astral's right). Restore the smooth natural uninterrupted glass side of the body exactly where that flipper was attached. The IMAGE-RIGHT flipper stays attached in exactly its calm resting position. Output exactly ONE complete Astral ghost body, with exactly ONE attached flipper on IMAGE-RIGHT and no flipper on IMAGE-LEFT. No detached parts.
Preserve aggressively: the same upright domed body and its original width; no wider or rounder redesign; exact same two white vertical oval eyes and their spacing, the same three rounded lower waves, same icy silver-blue dense matte translucent glass/jelly material, subtle lavender rim, same soft studio light from upper left, same frontal nearly orthographic camera, same body pose and scale. No tilt, waving, body stretch, squash or motion.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent RGBA background. No floor, no shadow and no cast shadow. Keep soft translucent antialiasing around the silhouette, no drawn checkerboard. One centered complete figure, no cropped parts.
Avoid: mouth, nose, pupils, permanent inner core, logos, symbols, music, text, labels, extra eyes, extra limbs, extra objects, multiple figures, sprite sheets, pose sequences. This plate will remain perfectly still throughout the animation. The only artistic edit is removal of the IMAGE-LEFT resting flipper and repair of that small side contour.

Upper-left reflections and edge contours are regenerated and not pixel-identical to B0.

prompt.exact_text:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE isolated flipper PNG layer for shoulder-pivot animation of Astral.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE only: the newly generated static body plate body-generated.png. Input image 2 is the PRIMARY FLIPPER SHAPE REFERENCE: Astral B raised-flipper frame-004.png. Use only its raised flipper on IMAGE-LEFT as the shape guide; do not reproduce the ghost body or face from either reference.
Primary request: draw exactly ONE isolated small soft flipper of the same dense icy-blue matte translucent glass/jelly as Astral B. The flipper is a compact softly curved vertical oval/teardrop, like B's raised flipper. Its rounded wide TIP points UP. A short soft narrowed connection zone points DOWN at the BOTTOM CENTER: that lower connection will be the shoulder pivot for rotation. The lower connection is a brief continuation of the same jelly, not a separate peg, stalk, ball, ring, socket or long arm. Keep the main body of the flipper oval and softly irregular, not a perfect geometric shape.
Composition: a single upright isolated flipper only, centered and filling most of a compact square transparent canvas with modest empty margin. One object; no sheet or variants. No body, face, eyes, nose, mouth or additional body fragment. No text.
Style: match the smooth dense frosted icy silver-blue jelly surface, soft whitish blue upper-left highlight, subtle lavender/blue rim and soft internal volume of the references. Light from upper left. The flipper is small relative to the referenced ghost; do not make a huge arm or hand.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent RGBA background with soft translucent antialiasing, no floor, no shadow, no drawn checkerboard.
Avoid: full ghost, torso, partial torso, eyes, any second part or extra object, long arm, palm, fingers, hand, sphere, tail, horn, logo, text, labels, music, decoration. Exactly ONE separate upright flipper with the tip at the top and a short narrowed shoulder connection at bottom center.

reference_order.role: STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE only; new body plate
PRIMARY SHAPE REFERENCE; only raised image-left flipper

inspection.orientation: Rounded tip up and slightly left; short narrowed connection at bottom, slightly right of canvas center.
inspection.pivot_note: Approximate visual center inside the short lower connection; verify and adjust with the cropped layer and final attachment. Coordinates are before root cropping/resizing.
defects: Flipper is slightly diagonal/bean-curved rather than a strictly vertical oval; requires initial rotation when assembling.
Lower connection is slightly right of exact canvas center.
A few small peripheral alpha speckles remain in raw output.
inspection.status: usable raw isolated flipper candidate; final shoulder attachment requires assembly review
